credibility.summary: Management over-promises on operational targets, missing both its FY26 minimum revenue target (INR 3,626 Cr vs INR 4,000 Cr) and working capital guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers: Management guided for minimum INR 4,000 crore revenue for FY26, but reported actual revenue came in lower at INR 3,626.4 crores.
Management expected working capital days of 70 to 85 days, but reported rolling 12-month working capital surged to 163 days.
Reported operating margins (15-16%) remain stable and match overall historical trends despite top-line guidance misses.

calls.tone: Confident in long-term strategy and execution, acknowledging balance sheet constraints and supply chain pressures.
